text_block_list.text:
One day after school, as Hishi Amazon was
walking through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Wanna buy some cabbage?
Fresh and delicious! It's a bargain!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh my, that startled me. What are you doing, Biko?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I'm helping to draw in customers!
The weather's been so good they harvested way too much cabbage, apparently."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"They said they still have a ton left and are in trouble.
A hero can't just look the other way at a time like this, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, now that's a fine attitude!
Guess I'll buy a couple of heads myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
However, they're not going down at all at this rate.
Alright, I'll help call out to customers too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Cabbage, get your cheap cabbage here!
Ah, customer over there, wanna buy some cabbage?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping Woman
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, we're having Salisbury steak tonight.
I already bought the meat and everything...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I seeee...
Oh, but how about serving it as a side dish!

text_block_list.name: Shopping Woman
text_block_list.text:
My child hates vegetables, you see.
They throw a fit just looking at them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Just by looking at it...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I know! Then why not chop up the cabbage finely
and mix it into the hamburger steak?

text_block_list.name: Shopping Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my kid might actually eat this then.
I'll take some cabbage!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sis, seems like this customer
has an upset stomach.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Then how about pot-au-feu? It'll warm you up, and the cabbage aids digestion.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What about you? Something cheap and hearty?
Then twice-cooked pork it is!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's all sold out! That's amazing, Sis!
Solving everything with cabbage, you really are Cabbage Woman!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Please, don't call me Cabbageman...
Well, I'm glad I could be of help."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, tailoring a strategy to your opponent...
Looks like that'll come in handy for races too!

From this day on, Hishi Amazon's tactical repertoire
expanded significantly.
